bullets.title: PLTR: Goldman upgrades to Buy, PT $230; U upgraded to Outperform at Raymond James, PT $54
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs upgraded Palantir to Buy from Neutral with a $230 PT, sending the stock up 2.6% pre-market. Raymond James separately upgraded Unity to Outperform from Market Perform with a $54 PT, with U up 2.1% pre-market.

bullets.title: MSFT & ADBE: Suspended from H-1B PERM program over federal investigations
bullets.body: The Trump administration suspended Microsoft and Adobe from the Permanent Labor Certification Program citing 'multiple active federal investigations' into alleged H-1B visa abuse. VP Vance named MSFT, ADBE, INFY, Wipro, Cognizant, HCL, Capgemini, and Tata as targeted firms; IT consulting stocks (ACN, CTSH, INFY) moved to lows on the news. Stock prices were flat on initial announcement.

bullets.title: TSMC: September revenue +54.6% y/y on AI chip demand surge
bullets.body: TSMC reported September revenue surging ~55% year-over-year driven by continued strong AI chip demand. Samsung also reported 3Q operating profit up ~9x on memory prices and HBM shipments. Wolfe Research is organizing an Asia semiconductor bus tour Dec 7-11 covering TSMC, SK Hynix, and Samsung for institutional clients.

bullets.title: ORCL & AVGO: Pursuing massive debt deals for AI chip buildout
bullets.body: Oracle is seeking ~$40B in financing via a special-purpose entity leasing model to fund NVDA chip purchases, while Broadcom is arranging $50B+ in financing (with APO/BX as lenders) for OpenAI custom AI chips. Morgan Stanley flags each 1GW deal in the SPCX context adds ~$27/share (~16% upside).

bullets.title: META Muse: #1 US App Store 21 days straight; >2M DAUs; agentic commerce threat escalates
bullets.body: META's Muse AI agent has held the #1 spot in the US App Store for 21 consecutive days with over 2M DAUs. Muse has been upgraded to negotiate bills directly with telecom, utility, and insurance providers, driving US telco/utility/insurance sectors down 15-25%. MS sees Muse potentially generating $27B+ revenue at scale and views it as the most credible agentic threat to commerce and advertising to date.

bullets.title: NFLX: MS bull case at 15x FY28 EPS; DIS deal, India, ads >50% growth as catalysts
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's Sean Diffley argues Netflix is undervalued at 15x FY28 EPS with double-digit revenue growth and 150-200bps margin expansion potential. Key catalysts include a DIS deal, India green shoots, sports programming, and advertising revenue growing >50%.

bullets.title: AMZN: AWS CEO bullish; $220B capex, 2M NVDA GPUs; Trainium largely committed
bullets.body: AWS CEO Matt Garman disclosed Amazon plans ~$220B in 2026 capex and purchases of ~2M Nvidia GPUs over several years. AWS revenue reached ~$169B growing 37%. Trainium capacity is largely committed into next year with Anthropic and OpenAI as anchor customers; Graviton chips offer ~20% cost savings.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Gemini Agent for enterprise launched; Unity 'Spark' gaming platform; Constellation Energy power deal
bullets.body: Google launched Gemini Agent for enterprise, positioning against OpenAI with model flexibility including Claude and open-source models. Google also launched Unity Spark, an AI gaming creation platform competing with Roblox via Google ecosystem distribution. Separately, Google entered a 3.6GW power deal with Constellation Energy but halted orders on two Finnish data centers.

bullets.title: UBER: $2.3B ezCater acquisition margin-accretive; Waymo $5B debt raise a competitive overhang
bullets.body: Uber acquired ezCater for $2.3B in cash; ezCater has 140K+ restaurants, $2.5B TTM gross bookings, high-teens YoY growth, and assumed 18% take rate making it margin-accretive with cross-sell potential for Uber Eats. Separately, Waymo upsized its private debt raise to $5B (from $3B) at 5.25% over benchmark, increasing competitive pressure on Uber as Waymo expands its 4,000+ vehicle fleet.

bullets.title: SPOT: Piper Sandler initiates neutral, $540 PT; Rogan re-upped ~$250M; audiobook expansion a 4Q margin headwind
bullets.body: Piper Sandler initiated Spotify at Neutral with a $540 PT, citing ads business rebuild headwinds and declining CPMs despite margin upside potential. Separately, Citi notes SPOT re-signed Joe Rogan for a multi-year deal estimated at ~$250M with the show now distributed across platforms; audiobook global expansion creates a margin headwind in 4Q26 before ARPU/GM expansion in 2027.

bullets.title: HUBS: JPMorgan downgrades to Neutral, cuts PT to $240 from $268
bullets.body: JPMorgan's Samik Chatterjee downgraded HubSpot to Neutral from Overweight and cut the price target to $240 from $268, implying ~9% upside vs. FactSet consensus of $248.

bullets.title: RBLX: 3Q26 bookings tracking high-end of guidance (~$1.65B); 4Q ~$1.96B; Citi PT $60
bullets.body: Citi expects Roblox 3Q26 bookings at the high end of guidance (~$1.65B) and 4Q26 bookings of ~$1.96B, maintaining a $60 PT on 28x 2028 FCF. However, 4Q CCUs are showing sequential slowdown and infrastructure costs remain elevated. The Google-Unity Spark platform is seen as a competitor but Roblox's 123M+ DAU social layer provides meaningful differentiation.

bullets.title: BKNG: Priceline facing FTC action with potential $500M+ fine over misleading ads
bullets.body: Booking Holdings' Priceline.com is facing an FTC enforcement action over allegedly misleading advertisements, with the potential fine exceeding $500M.

bullets.title: ACN: UBS reiterates Buy, $275 PT; Dell Business Group launch signals agentic AI monetization
bullets.body: UBS reiterates Buy on Accenture at $275 PT after the firm launched a new Dell Business Group focused on enterprise agentic AI workloads. UBS sees ~10% FCF yield vs 4% historical average and notes the 8 Emerging Alliances (NVDA, OpenAI, Palantir partnerships) are doubling revenue YoY with bookings tripling. Stock has retraced ~8% from $212 to $196 creating entry opportunity.

bullets.title: ANET & TEAM hit 52-week highs; semis broadly weaker pre-market
bullets.body: Arista Networks (+49.4% YTD) and Atlassian (+31.5% YTD) hit 52-week highs. In contrast, semiconductor stocks broadly declined pre-market: SOXX -1.65%, COHR -3.6%, LITE -3.8%, ARM -2.9%, MRVL -2.3%, CRDO -2.5%, ALAB -2.3%, AAOI -4.4%.

bullets.title: NBIS: Rosenblatt initiates Buy, $304 PT; CRWV/NBIS expert call tomorrow on neo-cloud capacity
bullets.body: Rosenblatt Securities initiated Nebius at Buy with a $304 price target. Oppenheimer is hosting an expert call tomorrow at 11am ET featuring a data center broker managing ~10GW of business, covering CoreWeave, Nebius, DigitalOcean, and Lambda Labs on AI training/inference demand and capacity gap duration.

bullets.title: RCL upgraded to Buy at Jefferies, PT $330; CCL Top Pick at MS for 2027
bullets.body: Jefferies upgraded Royal Caribbean to Buy from Hold with a PT raised to $330 from $305. Morgan Stanley separately names Carnival its Top Pick heading into 2027 on record occupancy, pricing, and accelerating onboard spend; CCL is also flagged as a beneficiary of agentic AI commerce due to owned content and high distribution costs.

bullets.title: NOW: JPM hosts elite ServiceNow partner call; AI Control Tower adoption accelerating at scale
bullets.body: JPMorgan hosted a webinar with CoreX CEO Richard Wright on ServiceNow, noting customers are increasingly adopting ServiceNow AI offerings at scale with AI Control Tower positioned as the enterprise-grade AI governance layer.

bullets.title: DKNG: NFL files amicus brief arguing prediction markets are gambling; regulatory overhang key risk
bullets.body: The NFL filed an amicus brief in a Supreme Court case arguing prediction markets constitute gambling and should be state-regulated. Prediction markets recorded $1.8B in trading volume on the first NFL Sunday of the season; regulatory uncertainty remains the key overhang for DraftKings.

bullets.title: GEV: Power/AI infra positioning at 3rd percentile; OPCO bullish into earnings on valuation reset
bullets.body: Oppenheimer notes Power/AI infrastructure stocks including GEV have seen positioning hit the 3rd percentile with valuations normalized per Goldman Sachs. OPCO views GEV as a top pick into earnings as the positioning reset creates an attractive entry; Mizuho is also hosting an expert call Oct 13 on Project Jupiter gas pipeline permitting relevant to GEV and data center power plays.
